name: Yaan Enterprises Limited
about: Yaan Enterprises Limited engages in the provision of construction services in India and internationally. The company operates through Travel and Tourism Operations, Sales of Precious and Semi-Precious Stones, and Works Contract Services segments. It is involved in work contracts related to road development, highways, and bridges; and trading precious and semi-precious stones. The company also offers flight bookings, hotel reservations, and travel packages through its travel search engine, as well as logistics and transport services. In addition, it is involved in agro products trading, e-commerce, real estate and handicrafts. The company was formerly known as Crown Tours Limited and changed its name to Yaan Enterprises Limited in November 2021. Yaan Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.
